feature: The right hand panel says labels and tools, never sentences
summary: No line in the panel runs past 40 characters or reads as a sentence any more. Explanations moved into hover tips, and Properties and Fades got a question mark in their header.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walks: transition-picker-at-a-cut-walk (clip picked) and sound-fades-in-the-panel-walk (sound picked).

try.do: Open a recording and click the second clip on the timeline. Compare the panel with the before picture.
Before, for comparison: the same panel with the three sentences.
Add Sample Music from the Library and click it. Compare with its before picture.
Before, for comparison: Fades with 'drag the diamonds on the lane' beside its title.
Rest the pointer on the question mark beside Fades, then click it.
Rest on 'No effects' under Effects, then open Blending and rest on Multiply.

evaluate: Does the panel now read as labels and tools, with no paragraphs left in the video sections?
Is the question mark in a section header the right place for 'drag the diamonds on the lane' and 'any property can be keyed'?
Is 'No effects' under an empty Effects list right, or would you rather that line showed nothing at all?
The Blending and Masked by lists now show names only, and each explanation is the row's hover tip. Do you miss the line under each name?
rough: Two lines the mocks print are now behind the question marks: 'drag the diamonds on the lane' (video-audio.html, Fades) and 'Any property can be keyed' (video.html, Animating). Your answer on the card ('no sentences in the panel') came after the mocks, so I followed it.
The Animating empty line is gone rather than shortened, because the header beside it already says 'nothing yet'.

The test reads every panel file, but a few lines are built in shared model code where it cannot see them. The ones I found (Blending's explanation, a stack's 'no room left over', a copy's arrangement note, the overflow report) were cut by hand. Another one could still be hiding.
The question mark shows its words as a hover tip and in a small popover when clicked. It is a new control in the section header, so judge whether it fits beside the kind chip and the drag handle.
